blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—Police seized more than P110 million worth of illegal drugs and arrested six suspected drug personalities during a week-long anti-illegal drug campaign across the Cordillera region from Oct. 26 to Nov. 1. In a statement, the Police Regional Office-Cordillera (PRO-CAR) said their operating units conducted 14 operations during the period, consisting of seven marijuana eradication operations, five buy-bust operations, one search warrant operation and one police response. The operations resulted in the confiscation of 548,130 fully grown marijuana plants, 9,000 marijuana seedlings, 1,060 marijuana leaves and fruiting tops, and 7.47 grams of suspected shabu, with a combined standard drug price of P110,164,002.80.
